source.library: Read the members of one or more of the user's entire saved Spotify collections. The scope is the library itself, not one named playlist or album.
source.playlist: Read the member songs of one specific named playlist owned by the user.
source.album: Read the member songs of one specific named album from the public Spotify catalog.
source.directory: Read the files and folders inside a source directory explicitly identified by the user.

operations.filter_genre: Keep only songs belonging to the explicitly requested music genre. This filters, without ranking or taking an action.
operations.rank: Select the requested number of songs with the highest or lowest value of a song attribute within the current scope. All requested eligibility filters must already be applied.
operations.count: Answer with the number of distinct songs in the current scope. Use only when counting these songs fully answers the request.
operations.titles: Return the title or titles of the current selected songs. Use when a song-title answer is requested and all source, filtering, ranking and quantity conditions have been met.
operations.play: Start playing the single selected song. Use only when the user requested playback and this is the intended song.

questions.source: Which available read supplies the source data for this request? It may be useful even if the final action requires a later step.
questions.libraries: Which personal Spotify collections supply all and only the member songs in scope? Select the exact combination.
questions.next: Which operation is justified next by the request and current data? Select NONE if the required transformation, entity or effect is unavailable.
questions.order: Which song attribute and direction determine the requested ranking?
questions.limit: How many ranked songs should remain for the next operation?
questions.genre: Which observed genre value does the user explicitly require?
questions.directory: Which path is the source directory whose existing entries must be inspected?
questions.entity: Which live entity is the one the user named? Select NONE when the returned results do not contain it.
questions.query: Which literal text from the request names the entity to look up?

skills.source: Distinguish a personal library, a named collection, and a directory. Use the actual data source, not just the topic.
skills.libraries: A named collection is not the user's entire library. Cover each collection explicitly requested, including unions.
skills.next: Match the requested entity and final effect. Apply necessary filters before limiting the set. A group-level statistic is different from a song-level statistic. Returning a title never plays a song.
skills.order: Use the attribute of the individual song. Release date and date added to a collection are different.
skills.residual: Use the public results in compiled for the part of the task they cover. Membership in each source collection is retained separately. Check outstanding conditions and complete the user's actual request.
